title: SaveState Lite
key_points: Godot addon for atomic save files, rolling .bak backups, schema versioning with forward merge, and one SaveManager autoload.
Separate Pro version available with additional features like async saving/loading and quick setup menu entries.
limitations: Does not ship a Saveable node in this repository; nodes that implement get_storage_key, collect_snapshot, and apply_snapshot can participate in save functionality.
Requires manual installation into Godot project folder.
asserts: This source claims that SaveState Lite centralizes atomic commits (write to temp → validate → rename), optional .bak backups, and a single schema number with merge-from-defaults for older files.
scope: The scope of this source's main claim is the Godot addon that centralizes save functionality in Godot projects, supporting versions 4.3-4.6.
